summary: KE Holdings Inc., a Cayman-incorporated China-based real estate services firm dual-listed on the NYSE and HKEX, filed a Form 6-K containing Hong Kong Stock Exchange next-day disclosure returns and a monthly return for August/September 2026. The exhibits detail a series of open-market share repurchases executed since May 2026, with over 20 transactions totaling roughly 5.6 million shares repurchased but not yet cancelled, at prices ranging from HK$36.08 to HK$45.01 per share on the HKEX and US$5.72 per ADS on the NYSE. No board recommendation or financial advisor is named; filings are routine HKEX disclosure. The repurchases appear part of an ongoing capital-return program, likely to offset dilution and support share price. Watch for continuation of buybacks and potential cancellation of repurchased shares.
